Geometry setup constructs x8BC and resets processed component accumulators. Both visible row functions explicitly decode four Y blocks, one U and one V rather than reading that schedule.

The driver casts its s32 argument to THPDecodeInfo*, installs three destinations and executes the row loop without a final wait. OSCache confirms queued stores and threshold-based waiting, supporting the qualified completion boundary.

Verified u8 loop index versus u16 count, restart decrement/reload and predictor reset, and exact transfer sizes. OSCache splits 0x2800 into three transactions and each 0xA00 into one, totaling five; no final drain is present.

The general-width routine has the stated index limitation, restart transitions, integer x/16 transfer arithmetic and destination increments. Its entry wait allows up to three outstanding transactions and does not establish final completion.
The two count formulas and aligned word load match canonical lines 88–98 exactly. Subtraction by (3-offset)*8 is not generally equivalent to the bytes rewound.

SOS tests selector and selector+1 bits, whereas DHT and preparation use doubled table indices. Verified status 12/15, partial mutations, workspace advancement, trailing-byte skip, and delegated report-and-zero versus capacity-error paths.
